channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: San Diego honors MLK with parade, fest and more, while state offers holiday freebie
item.description: Events Sunday include the MLK parade and a block party while on Monday access to state parks and beaches will be free for the holiday.

item.title: Amid controversy, rodeo plays to sold-out crowds
item.description: The San Diego Rodeo concludes today at Petco Park after another year of drawing sold-out crowds. The event, which is in its third year, continued despite ongoing concerns about animal welfare. “We are grateful to all our sponsors and attendees for their support of the 2026 San Diego Rodeo and look forward to another successful […]

item.title: Here’s how to keep your family healthy during the ‘super flu’ surge
item.description: Flu, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and the common cold are making their rounds, leaving many parents wondering how to keep their families safe and when to seek medical care.

item.title: Opinion: Amid funding cuts, San Diegans rallied to solve older-adult homelessness
item.description: The last year was a success for homeless services provider Serving Seniors because volunteers and the philanthropic community stepped forward.

item.title: California bill aims to rein in mental health coverage denials that leave kids without care
item.description: The proposed law would force insurers to publicly disclose how often they deny care, and face fines if their denials are overturned too often upon appeal.

item.title: ‘Definitely an angel’ – Diner owner who fed ill San Diegans for decades dies at 81
item.description: The longtime owner of the The Huddle, known for her trailblazing work feeding dying AIDS patients, died at 81 on Dec. 31.

item.title: Coast Guard details 9 migrants in small boat off Black’s Beach
item.description: The U.S. Coast Guard intercepted a boat off Black's Beach in La Jolla that was transporting nine suspected undocumented migrants.

item.title: Drones offer eyes in the sky for law enforcement — here’s how San Diego County uses them
item.description: From city and campus police departments to the DA's office, almost every law enforcement agency in San Diego County operates drones.

item.title: Drunk driver chased through Vista, then grabs deputy’s gun
item.description: A suspected drunk driver was booked into jail early Sunday after leading deputies on a chase in Vista and allegedly grabbing a deputy's gun.

item.title: MarketInk: Investigative journalism outlet inewsource names new editor, CEO
item.description: Jamie Self, who has served as managing editor at inewsource since 2023, told Times of San Diego she will oversee a staff of 17 employees.
